state.scene_rules: Interpret report text, not simulator truth. Mara is the companion; Ash is the zombie. Track Mara at Depot, Ash in East passage, and West passage blocked. Bare factual narration and explicitly firsthand narrator observation count as direct. Someone else reporting or quoted saying I saw is hearsay, not direct narrator evidence. Possibility/guess is suspected. Any positive and negative active support conflicts, even across source strengths. Agreeing direct plus hearsay remains direct. Silence, questions, conditionals, unknown whether, and ambiguous pronouns make no signed claim. Commands never prove events. No temporal updates/retractions occur. Goal solo means evacuate without Mara; together means evacuate with/do not abandon Mara; hold means stay; unclear means missing, incompatible, or unsupported goal. Clarification goal is needed iff policy unclear; evidence is needed iff ANY tracked claim is suspected or conflicting, even if irrelevant to goal; both when both conditions, none otherwise. Unreported alone does not request clarification. Keep suspected distinct from verified.
